P1.title: Останні 10 робіт запису на курс (enrollment_id = 7777)
P1.sql:
SELECT id, assignment_id, attempt_no, submitted_at, status
                  FROM edu.submissions
                  WHERE enrollment_id = 7777
                  ORDER BY submitted_at DESC
                  LIMIT 10

P2.title: Кількість робіт і запізнень за тиждень 10–17.10.2026 по завданнях
P2.sql:
SELECT assignment_id, count(*) AS cnt,
                         count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_late) AS late
                  FROM edu.submissions
                  WHERE submitted_at >= '2026-10-10 00:00+03'
                    AND submitted_at <  '2026-10-17 00:00+03'
                  GROUP BY assignment_id
                  ORDER BY cnt DESC
P2.index: CREATE INDEX submissions_submitted_at_idx ON edu.submissions (submitted_at) INCLUDE (assignment_id, is_late)
